root.label: FBI jobs website hacked by ShinyHunters

events.label: FBI jobs website hacked by ShinyHunters

slots.name: data volume
slots.sentence: The hackers said they stole 2 to 3 terabytes of data related to FBI workers, a feat they accomplished thanks to a new vulnerability with Oracle PeopleSoft, a human resources management program.

events.label: FBI removes contractor after jobs website breach

slots.name: contractor status
slots.sentence: "The FBI has removed the contractor and taken all necessary steps to both mitigate any further risk and protect our workforce," Leatherman said in a statement.
